title: Douglas Elliman Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Douglas Elliman Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 10, 2026 disclosing amendments to employment agreements for two executive officers: CFO J. Bryant Kirkland III and General Counsel Bradley H. Brodie. The amendments increased base salaries and target bonus percentages, added retention bonuses for Mr. Kirkland, and revised severance provisions including change-in-control protections.
key_points: J. Bryant Kirkland III base salary increased to $650,000 per annum, effective January 1, 2026
Kirkland target bonus opportunity increased to 65% of base salary
Kirkland to receive $150,000 one-time retention bonus payable on earlier of December 15, 2026 or qualifying termination
Bradley H. Brodie base salary increased to $575,000 per annum, effective January 1, 2026
Brodie target bonus opportunity increased to 50% of base salary
Both executives now have 12-month severance periods with bonus based on target (not actual) performance
